input.quote: 9.5 Termination of one Order Form does not terminate another Order Form unless Customer states that the affected Services are operationally inseparable. A termination right is in addition to, and does not exclude, any other remedy available under this Agreement or Applicable Law.
input.rationale: Section 9 provides only termination for material breach (9.1), insolvency (9.2) and our special cause triggers (9.3); there is no termination-for-convenience right anywhere, in a three-year term (Section 8.1). Absence of a Customer convenience right in a multi-year term is our walk-away, so we have inserted a new 9.6 giving us 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund keyed to Section 10.2, and confirming Vendor has no convenience right during a committed term.

input.quote: Each Order Form renews for twelve months unless either Party gives one hundred eighty days' advance written notice.
input.rationale: The renewal term (12 months) and the Section 8.3 uplift cap (lesser of CPI and 3%, 90 days' notice) meet our position, but a 180-day non-renewal window exceeds even our walk-away threshold of 90 days. We have shortened the opt-out to 30 days and added a 60-day Vendor renewal reminder; 60 days is our fallback.

input.quote: This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: New York law with exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts of New York County is exactly our preferred position, with no arbitration. CISG is excluded, and the Section 28.3 executive escalation expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings.

input.quote: Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Preferred position met: we may assign to Affiliates and successors without consent (24.1); Vendor may not assign, delegate or transfer by change of control without our consent and never to a competitor (24.2); and 24.4 bars any Vendor termination, suspension, repricing or fee acceleration on our change of control. Section 24.3's catch-all applies only to "other assignments" and does not cut back 24.1, and Section 13.3 aligns licence transfer with Section 24.
